How to Dissolve & Close a US LLC Legally (Articles of Cancellation & IRS Closure)

A step-by-step legal dissolution roadmap for foreign non-resident founders on state Articles of Dissolution, final IRS tax filings, Mercury/Relay bank account liquidations, and closing IRS EIN tax accounts.

ADVAQ US Legal Team
8 Min Read · Published July 2026
State & IRS Corporate Dissolution Protocols
5-Step Legal Dissolution Roadmap
  1. Member Resolution: Formal written consent to dissolve approved by LLC owners.
  2. Settle Business Debts: Pay off all vendor invoices and tax liabilities.
  3. Close US Bank Accounts: Liquidate balances via final Owner's Draw wire.
  4. File State Articles of Dissolution: Submit Articles of Cancellation with Secretary of State.
  5. Final IRS Filing & EIN Closure: Mark "Final Return" on Form 5472 and mail EIN cancellation letter to IRS.

1. Why You Must Dissolve Legally (Risks of Abandonment)

Simply walking away from an active US LLC without formal dissolution is a dangerous mistake.

The state will continue to assess annual report fees and penalties. Furthermore, the IRS may continue issuing automatic $25,000 late penalties for unfiled Form 5472 tax returns until the entity is legally closed.

2. State Filings: Wyoming ($60) vs Delaware ($200)

Wyoming LLC Dissolution

File Articles of Dissolution with the Wyoming Secretary of State. State fee is $60. All annual reports must be current.

Delaware LLC Cancellation

File a Certificate of Cancellation with Delaware Division of Corporations. State fee is $200 + all paid franchise taxes ($300/yr).

3. Closing Mercury & Relay Business Bank Accounts

Transfer remaining funds to your personal foreign bank account as a final Owner's Draw, download all historical PDF statements for 6-year tax records, and request official account closure from Mercury or Relay support.

4. Submitting Final IRS Form 5472 & 1120 Returns

On your final Form 1120 and Form 5472 filing for the year of dissolution, check the box marked "Final Return". This notifies the IRS that no future tax returns will be expected.

5. How to Close Your IRS EIN Business Tax Account

Mail a formal written notice to:

Internal Revenue Service
MS 6273, Cincinnati, OH 45999 USA

Include your full company name, EIN, US business address, reason for closure, and a copy of your IRS CP575 confirmation letter.
